mapper.select: SELECT a.sample_id,b.person_id,a.subbarcode,a.received_date,a.person_name,a.gender,a.birthday,a.clinicalremark,a.remark,a.cancertype,a.specimen_quantity,a.hospital,a.collect_date FROM omics.sample_file a left outer join omics.person b on b.person_id = a.person_id where a.person_name = #{person_name} and a.gender = #{gender}
SELECT person_id FROM omics.person where person_name =#{0} and gender =#{1}
mapper.update: update sample_file set person_id = #{1} where sample_id = #{0}
mapper.select: select sample_id,subbarcode FROM omics.sample_file where person_id=#{id}
